events.speaker: advocate
events.text: Thank you for calling Humana. This call is being recorded.

events.speaker: advocate
events.text: CenterWell can deliver a 90-day supply. You can keep retail for some medicines. Enrollment is optional and does not change today's pickup.

events.speaker: member
events.text: Keep the atorvastatin at retail. I would like to try delivery for the metformin.

events.pauseLabel: T08B: Confirm (mint) metformin-only. Do not submit.

events.speaker: advocate
events.text: I can add atorvastatin to the draft selection as well.

events.pauseLabel: T08B: Add atorvastatin to draft — prior confirmation is invalid.

events.speaker: member
events.text: I don't want to enroll. Please withdraw that. Stop the enrollment.

events.pauseLabel: T08B: withdrawal blocks submit. No business action.

events.speaker: advocate
events.text: Your decision today has no impact on your plan membership.

events.pauseLabel: T08B: closing remains; enrollment not submitted.
